assumptions.claim: quoteToken.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), grossAmount) increases quoteToken.balanceOf(address(this)) by the exact grossAmount without fee-on-transfer deduction, rebasing, or untrusted callback hooks.
assumptions.establishedBy: nothing found (RaffleFactory.sol:L66, L70-L78 only checks deployed code presence and decimals() == 6; exact transfer semantics rely on the trusted quoteToken_ constructor argument)

assumptions.claim: ticketCount < type(uint128).max prior to ++ticketCount so the uint128 increment does not overflow and ticketId == uint256(ticketCount).
assumptions.establishedBy: packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L218-L221, L230-L231 (each call requires entryCount >= 1 and entryCount <= type(uint128).max - totalEntries, maintaining ticketCount <= totalEntries <= type(uint128).max - 1 prior to increment)

assumptions.claim: A future Raffle clone address that has not yet been deployed via Clones.clone (and thus currently has code.length == 0 and isRaffle == false) is not supplied as recipient before its creation.
assumptions.establishedBy: nothing found (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L602-L604 only queries canonicalFactory.isRaffle(destination) when destination.code.length != 0, and RaffleFactory.sol:L125 sets isRaffle only during createRaffle)

assumptions.claim: Re-entry from IERC721Receiver(recipient).onERC721Received into non-guarded ERC721 functions (transferFrom, safeTransferFrom, approve, setApprovalForAll) during _safeMint does not violate Raffle accounting because all Raffle storage writes complete before _safeMint.

callers: External entrypoint reachable by any caller during Status.Active before endTime (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L209); no internal callers.

calls.propagates: Reverts if REENTRANCY_GUARD_STORAGE == ENTERED (2) and sets the slot to ENTERED (2) for the duration of buyEntries before resetting to NOT_ENTERED (1), blocking re-entry into any nonReentrant function on the same Raffle clone (ReentrancyGuard.sol:L69-L73, L88-L114). Does not block inherited ERC721 transfer/approval functions (ERC721.sol:L93-L136).
Establishes status == Status.Active on all non-reverting paths (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L573-L575).

Calls quoteToken.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), grossAmount) and reverts unless the call succeeds and either returns true (1) or returns empty data on a contract with extcodesize > 0 (SafeERC20.sol:L43-L47, L212-L244). Does not verify the recipient balance delta.

calls.callee: ERC721._safeMint -> ERC721._mint -> Raffle._update -> Raffle._isProtocolDestination -> ERC721._update -> ERC721Utils.checkOnERC721Received
calls.propagates: Verifies recipient != address(0) and _owners[ticketId] == address(0) (ERC721.sol:L260-L266); rejects recipient if _isProtocolDestination(recipient, address(prizeToken)) is true (Raffle.sol:L498-L500, L593-L605, querying canonicalFactory.raffleImplementation() at L601 and canonicalFactory.isRaffle(recipient) at L603 only when recipient.code.length != 0 at L602); increments _balances[recipient] and writes _owners[ticketId] = recipient (ERC721.sol:L236, L240); and only when recipient.code.length > 0 calls untrusted IERC721Receiver(recipient).onERC721Received(msg.sender, address(0), ticketId, "") requiring the ERC721Receiver selector (ERC721Utils.sol:L32-L48).

invariants.claim: Entry purchases only succeed when status == Status.Active and block.timestamp < endTime, making buyEntries strictly mutually exclusive with requestDraw (which requires block.timestamp >= endTime at L242).

Every minted ticket represents a non-empty, 1-based inclusive range [firstEntry, lastEntry] with 1 <= firstEntry <= lastEntry <= totalEntries <= type(uint128).max and lastEntry - firstEntry + 1 == entryCount.
Minted ticketIds are sequential 1-based integers 1..ticketCount whose stored _ticketRanges partition [1, totalEntries] into contiguous, disjoint intervals without gaps or overlaps.
While status == Status.Active, unsettledPot == uint256(totalEntries) * ENTRY_PRICE == grossSales().

All Raffle storage writes (totalEntries, ticketCount, _ticketRanges[ticketId], unsettledPot) and ERC-721 ownership writes (_balances[recipient], _owners[ticketId]) occur before the untrusted IERC721Receiver(recipient).onERC721Received callback in _safeMint.
